title: A common convention for graded correspondences and exchange
would_establish: A single variance, degree, symmetry and gauge convention supporting composition, units, graphs and tensor products, with every exchange square stated.
known: The ordinary even construction is established; the all-degree tensor formula was itself rejected in the manuscript. A Cartesian square alone does not imply the required exchange identity in an arbitrary gauged category. Hua’s checked theorem is ungraded and has explicit axioms.
first_step: Tabulate the maps and degrees at11/002–012 and044–048, list the squares used by the associativity and graph proofs, and choose one odd-degree test object.
one_run_limit: A complete convention and finite axiom inventory is realistic. A general new base-change theorem is outside this task.

title: A concordance of weight, level, coniveau and the two dimension filtrations
would_establish: A definition and implication table showing which filtration is used on each leaf, how Tate twist acts, and what a realization theorem actually implies.
known: Early D is Tate-stable; late type is bounded untwisted source dimension. Hodge and weight bounds do not by themselves identify geometric motivic level or coniveau. The2026 abelian statements affect specified subcases only.
first_step: Place the generators at12/035–036 beside12/125, then compare the unit, the Tate line, elliptic H1 and a normal-crossing top class before mapping theorem dependencies.
one_run_limit: A reliable concordance and hypothesis graph can be completed in hours. Equality of the general conjectural filtrations cannot be inferred from it.

title: Corrected global and local bounds for varying geometric coefficients
would_establish: An exact table of valid coarse bounds, disproved sharper bounds and the separate surviving coefficient-level questions.
known: Legendre satisfies the relevant strict geometric coefficient hypothesis and gives the obstructing weight4 or weight0 terms. Constant coefficients, finite monodromy, boundary unipotence and arithmetic invariants require different statements.
first_step: Write the local and global hypotheses side by side and preserve the documentary change from assertion at51 to question at108; then choose one corrected target with a specified monodromy condition.
one_run_limit: A short counterexample-and-correction companion is feasible. A new general geometric-level theorem requires additional input.

title: The kernel of the realized diagonal algebra
would_establish: The relation ideal of the diagonal diagram algebra in one fixed graded Poincaré algebra and number of factors.
known: The audited P1 example disproves the unrestricted word “basis”; it does not classify the kernel. Hua’s multigraph multiplication rule does not assert faithfulness of every realization.
first_step: Fix a coefficient field, a normalized top class and a model with nonzero odd cohomology, and specify the realization homomorphism before seeking relations.
one_run_limit: A small explicitly bounded case is realistic; arbitrary varieties and all factor counts are a separate research programme.

title: Coherent integral lattices and rationalization
would_establish: A conditional integral category with precise denominator control and separately proved Hom finiteness, kernels, cokernels, internal Hom and rational quotient properties.
known: Arbitrary prime-by-prime lattices can yield a Hom subgroup of Q containing1/l for every prime. Ambient extension closure already fails for simple finite torsion examples. The rational motive category remains an assumed input.
first_step: Define reference systems and their allowed equivalence relation, then test tensor, Hom, kernels and cokernels on rational lines, Z/l and mixed lattice systems.
one_run_limit: A rigorous conditional axiom package is plausible in one run. It would be our reconstruction, not a recovered theorem on the pages.

title: Weight-one essential image, extension and purity: an exact case table
would_establish: A historically ordered account separating traits, low ramification, higher-dimensional nonextension, extension of morphisms and independence of a detecting prime.
known: The Néron–Ogg–Shafarevich criterion, the extension theorem for already existing maps, finite-étale purity and Vasiu–Zink’s object counterexamples have different hypotheses. All-prime unramifiedness alone does not settle the unrestricted mixed-characteristic local-base question.
first_step: Read the exact de Jong–Oort1997§6 source and available earlier purity references, then align each theorem with the source’s base, prime order and object-versus-morphism wording.
one_run_limit: A dependable history and hypothesis table is feasible. The broad one-prime criterion for arbitrary motives is not a few-hour target.

title: The absolute unit and its finite-field comparison
would_establish: A consistent small formal model of the proposed absolute cohomology, stating exactly which continuity, odd-unit and duality axioms can coexist.
known: The written degree-multiplication restrictions and H1(Fq,Q)=Q have nonzero direct limit. Ordinary profinite rational cohomology, Weil-group cohomology and Weil-étale motivic cohomology are different inputs. The odd identification also needs a normalization.
first_step: Extract only the unit calculations and transition maps from60–71 and the reused69 continuation, then compare them with the precisely checked finite-field Weil-étale splitting.
one_run_limit: A complete incompatibility/dependency table and a bounded replacement model are realistic. The full absolute motivic heart is not constructed by that comparison.

title: Sha, Brauer and constant Jacobians with degree conventions fixed
would_establish: A single exact-sequence companion distinguishing rational points, torsor groups, Tate modules, finite errors and Brauer residues over curves.
known: The inverse-Kummer constant-Jacobian counterexample contradicts literal H2-vanishing without assuming Sha finiteness. Removing r≥1 closed points gives Brauer corank r−1 through normalized local invariants. Singular proper schemes need not satisfy the smooth high-degree weight vanishing.
first_step: Draw the Kummer and localization sequences with coefficients and bases fixed, mark every inverse-limit hypothesis, and separate the global-function-field rank equivalence from full BSD.
one_run_limit: A complete corrected curve case and comparison table is realistic. The general finiteness conjectures remain outside this task.

title: Analytic Galois Lie algebras versus algebraic monodromy
would_establish: A precise reconstruction target distinguishing analytic invariants, associative envelopes, Zariski groups and a proposed motivic Lie object.
known: The double-centralizer argument recovers an algebra under semisimplicity; it does not select individual cycles or recover the group. A procyclic finite-field image can have analytic dimension1 and algebraic torus dimension2.
first_step: State the four objects and their comparison maps for the checked elliptic Frobenius example, then specify which one the l-independent proposal is intended to realize.
one_run_limit: A clean conditional theorem and counterexample boundary can be written in hours. General l-independence remains a larger problem.

title: Primitive Tate strings and the two associated graded rings
would_establish: A coherent algebraic presentation preserving the unit, negative Tate powers and the distinction between weight grading and early D-grading.
known: The literal alpha=0 subtraction and polynomial wording after inversion fail elementary tests. Early D is unchanged by Tate twist, whereas weight moves by2.
first_step: List simple-object Tate orbits under the stated semisimplicity assumptions, choose the primitive boundary convention, and test multiplication before identifying either associated graded ring.
one_run_limit: A conditional normal-form account is highly feasible; it must not silently resolve the ink or claim the general category exists.

title: A Karoubi-envelope companion with a separate geometric application test
would_establish: A short noncircular proof of the abstract envelope, corner morphisms, kernels/cokernels, finite length, tensor extension and characteristic-zero Schur operations.
known: The formal results were independently checked against Demazure and Jannsen. Jannsen’s numerical-motive theorem is distinct from identifying a homological category or obtaining all standard conjectures.
first_step: Begin with the manuscript’s quotient of intertwiners and prove its equivalence to the corner description, recording the projection typing alarm before choosing modern notation.
one_run_limit: A complete expository companion is highly feasible. The concluding geometric application must retain its exact hypotheses.

title: Integral quadric normalizations and degeneration
would_establish: One dimension-indexed table of rulings, restriction, Gysin, primitive generators, local groups and specialization.
known: The integral ruling basis differs from the sum/difference sublattice by index2. Finite2-primary coefficients can have an adjacent group. The monodromy claim requires ordinary smoothing or regular total space; square base change removes the naive conclusion.
first_step: Fix integral ruling classes, coefficient rings and relative dimension, then place all source formulas in that convention and list the remaining scan signs.
one_run_limit: A complete corrected classical table is feasible. This is a normalization and exposition task, not an open calculation of quadric cohomology.

title: The nested-torus assertion and its maximal-torus correction
would_establish: An independently reviewable correction note with explicit lattice data and the exact valid maximal-torus version.
known: The broad wording fails for the checked nested tori in SL4. Conjugacy in the centralizer proves the maximal-torus statement. The checked re-edition retains the broad text, but the original printing has not been collated.
first_step: Inspect the original1970 page against the re-edited witness, then present the counterexample and corrected hypotheses without depending on an attribution of the textual defect.
one_run_limit: The mathematical note is highly feasible; edition history depends on obtaining the original page. No contact with editors is part of this proposed task.

title: The determinant series and endomorphism Grothendieck ring
would_establish: A companion distinguishing finite-dimensional field objects from projective modules, zero eigenvalues from automorphisms, and virtual semisimplification from Jordan data.
known: The zero-operator class lies in the determinant kernel; over a field the reduced description is exact. Reciprocal factors, the lambda sign and the weight-shift Euler parity have separate corrections. Equal power traces do not recover nilpotent Jordan structure.
first_step: Specify the exact category over a field first, prove its factorization map and kernel, then add only the ring generalization supported by a newly opened exact source.
one_run_limit: The field companion is highly feasible. The unverified Almkvist bibliographic lead must be opened before relying on the full ring theorem.

title: Positive cones and the precise semisimplicity mechanism
would_establish: A conditional cone formalism with correct Tate targets, parity, real topology and a clearly stated nondegeneracy-to-splitting argument.
known: The manuscript already assumes a semisimple setting. Weight zero alone does not make an object trivial, and invariance alone does not make a form positive. The Hodge and abelian standard-conjecture comparisons have stated scopes.
first_step: Separate existence of positive forms from their closure properties, realify each form space, and test the tensor and orthogonal-complement axioms on the unit and h1 of an elliptic curve.
one_run_limit: A precise conditional reconstruction is feasible. It does not prove the general positivity conjecture.

title: Fibre-functor torsors, neutrality and arithmetic splitting
would_establish: An exact dependency chart separating a tensor category, a fibre functor, its torsor, the Artin comparison and a chosen arithmetic splitting.
known: Neutral reconstruction, torsor representability and finite-generator criteria are established with Tannakian hypotheses. The supersingular quaternion obstruction and a nonsplit torus-lattice sequence show why stronger conclusions need extra assumptions.
first_step: Normalize the variance of every fibre functor and list what each assertion needs: characteristic, connectedness, finite type, a chosen point or a splitting.
one_run_limit: A bounded theorem-by-theorem companion is feasible. General period genericity and existence of the full motive category remain separate.

title: The general-base programme and modern six operations
would_establish: A comparison of each proposed abelian general-base axiom with an exact modern triangulated or realization-level theorem.
known: Six operations, continuity and relative motivic Galois constructions have precise modern versions. They do not automatically construct the manuscript’s abelian heart, finite-dimensional absolute theory or all proposed comparison functors.
first_step: Make an axiom table with base, coefficients, variance and target category, then align the checked Cisinski–Déglise and Ayoub statements one at a time.
one_run_limit: A complete hypothesis map is realistic. Existence of a general motivic t-structure is not a short residual exercise.

title: Restricted birational reconstruction and the scissors quotient
would_establish: A well-posed restricted functor or field-reconstruction statement that survives the section/retraction and rational-homological tests.
known: A nondominant section can compose with a projection to the identity. Rational realization can erase the Enriques obstruction. Brackets in the source may mean a purely transcendental field extension, so the polynomial-units argument is conditional. Nonruledness alone does not prove a graded scissors class is nonzero.
first_step: Fix the allowed maps and the exact quotient/equivalence relation, adjudicate the bracket notation from scans when available, then choose one restricted reconstruction target.
one_run_limit: A sharp formulation and boundary examples are feasible. A general birational or anabelian reconstruction theorem is not promised.

title: Finite-set reconstruction versus Frobenius and special power systems
would_establish: A three-way theorem comparison: finite-projective Frobenius data, special commutative ungraded systems with multiplicative gauges, and the wider unfinished graded theory.
known: Kock’s exact Frobenius result and Hua2026 Theorem1.2 settle restricted statements. The partition-system example disproves unrestricted evaluation at a point. Reported Lean verification was not executed in this run.
first_step: Collate the source’s specialness, empty-set and gauge hypotheses against the checked version, then formulate the residual graded or degenerate question without importing omitted axioms.
one_run_limit: A precise comparison is feasible; a classification of the wider systems is not already supplied by the cited restricted theorem.

title: Curve reduction with the corrected late type target
would_establish: A complete conditional proof audit of geometric-type preservation, or an explicit minimal missing lemma.
known: The late minus-one target fails for the torus embedding example. The compact-support two-row and proper three-row Leray arguments differ; the formal middle-row E3=E∞ statement does not itself identify geometric type.
first_step: Rewrite135–137 as functors and filtrations, marking each use of subquotients, direct summands, semisimplicity and a curve reduction.
one_run_limit: A complete audit is possible. An unconditional new closure theorem may not follow from the available inputs.

title: The relative L-function programme with generic-fibre equivalence fixed
would_establish: A precise candidate invariant modulo proper-closed-base contributions, with the actual smoothness, properness and weight cutoffs stated.
known: Trace formulas and rationality give exact related results, while the source’s proposed quotient and final adjective list remain unresolved. The highest-weight cutoff needs the coefficient weight shift.
first_step: Choose a base and coefficient category, define the subgroup of boundary contributions, and test generic-fibre invariance on a single fibration with a controlled bad fibre.
one_run_limit: A meaningful definition and finite set of tests are feasible. No exact general published invariant with all source rules was identified in the bounded search.

title: A versioned audit of the2026 abelian implications
would_establish: A version and hypothesis map from each announced CM/abelian theorem to the manuscript’s relevant subcases.
known: The6October CM-Hodge preprint and9November Milne report were opened and their exact statements checked. Their long new proofs were not independently audited here. Rational CM Hodge, finite-field abelian Tate and abelian standard-conjecture statements must remain distinct from arbitrary varieties and integral cycles.
first_step: Obtain the original version history and compare revisions, then open the earlier implication papers and corrigenda before choosing one bounded implication chain to audit.
one_run_limit: A source/version map is realistic. A full proof review of the53-page new preprint is a separate longer task.

title: The exact total-space integrality question in the cancelled EGA draft
would_establish: An exact theorem comparison specifying whether a published result answers the intended total-space assertion under the missing base and flatness hypotheses.
known: The literal unreduced formulation is false. Murayama’s checked corollary concerns all fibres, while its warning excludes a naive domain-ascent shortcut. A fibrewise theorem is not automatically the desired total-space theorem.
first_step: Obtain final EGAIV2§7.9 and its localization references, then state and test the bridge from fibrewise punctual integrality to the intended total-space conclusion.
one_run_limit: A source-and-hypothesis decision is feasible. The dossier does not claim the intended question is still open in the literature.

title: The separating-family and generic-freeness draft
would_establish: The correct module, localization and missing hypotheses of the reused algebra lemma, compared with final EGAIV3.
known: The attached witnesses share the malformed B_h/A_h expression but assign different scan labels. EGAIV3 11.9.7–11.9.10 and the separate11.9.8 question provide bounded comparisons, not permission to replace ink.
first_step: Recover the preceding proposition and inspect the source scan, then compare the support-induction argument with the final printed proof.
one_run_limit: An exact editorial reconstruction is highly feasible once those witnesses are available; no new generic-freeness theorem is required.

title: Nilpotent density and its inherited hypothesis
would_establish: A corrected ordinary lifting lemma and a separate assessment of the universal-relative variant.
known: The square-zero example disproves the literal ordinary assertion. SGA3II IX4.2 supplies a sufficient locally-free-layer condition. The example does not settle the universally dense relative formulation.
first_step: Read the preceding manuscript context for that layer condition and then state the relative version independently, with its base-change quantifier.
one_run_limit: A precise editorial correction and one bounded relative test are feasible; the two assertions must not be merged.

title: Delzant’s two questions and the exact comparison maps
would_establish: A historical companion explaining the passage from the rank-zero ideal in GW to the fundamental ideal in W and the actual degree-two symbol comparison.
known: Milnor and Merkurjev settle the relevant questions, but merely naming the later theorem omits a necessary ideal identification. The attached offprint was read; its strict external bibliography status remains unverified. The exact Springer1959 normalization still needs direct source inspection.
first_step: Obtain the exact Springer passage and original offprint record, then present the comparison square and separate first circulation from publication.
one_run_limit: A concise companion is feasible. It is documentary completion, not a new open norm-residue problem.

title: Rational attainment in the GIT exercise
would_establish: A self-contained proof with all nonemptiness, rational-weight and norm hypotheses explicit.
known: Finite rational polyhedral faces give the relevant bounded optimization argument; a stronger instability theorem is not a substitute for proving this exact exercise. Empty direction spaces and irrational norms require separate treatment.
first_step: State the direction space and norm precisely, reduce to faces, and list the assumptions under which a rational maximizing ray exists.
one_run_limit: A complete short proof is realistic. It should be presented as completion of a classical exercise.

title: GIT physical pagination and the determinant-cone continuation
would_establish: A page-order concordance and exact coordinate collation of the already established configuration criterion.
known: Both attached continuation pieces were read. Missing3.5/3.16 and incomplete OCR leave documentary gaps; they do not make the classical criterion open. The separating functional must be nonzero, and stability differs from semistability.
first_step: Match opening and closing sentences to a specific edition or typescript state and retrieve the missing physical pages before filling any local formula.
one_run_limit: A concordance is feasible; full collation depends on the missing pages. Diagonal partitions and GIT R-partitions stay separate.

title: The reflection typescript: faulty equality, valid corollary and provenance
would_establish: A correction companion distinguishing the chamber complement, false dual-angle equality and true nonnegative-angle corollary.
known: The essential A3 calculation refutes the equality; inverse-Gram positivity supplies the corollary. The affine local-finiteness proof can be completed under properness. Exact identification of numbered typescript383 is still unverified.
first_step: Collate III-2 andIII-5 against the original scans and a candidate edition, then write the corrected proof without attributing the reused typescript to Grothendieck.
one_run_limit: The bounded mathematics is feasible; provenance depends on finding the actual numbered document.

title: The two reported Deligne manuscripts and their chronology
would_establish: A dated source chain for the perfect-complex lambda report and the separate conditional Leray/Lefschetz report.
known: The lambda report already announces a solution within its written scope. The Leray report needs a relative operator. Modern theorem statements do not identify the manuscript Grothendieck had seen or its circulation date.
first_step: Compare B12/121 and123 with SGA6 editorial material and Deligne1968, adding contemporary correspondence only if subsequently supplied.
one_run_limit: A documentary concordance may be completed in hours; the undated reports must not inherit the secretary letter’s27March1968 date.

title: The selected-map and nonadditive variants as exact axiom questions
would_establish: A minimal statement of the allowed maps and operations that the unfinished variants retain.
known: The source leaves these variants open. The ordinary correspondence theory and special finite-set theorem do not settle omitted variance, additivity or base-change requirements.
first_step: Extract the surviving operations and every explicit cancellation, then formulate one small category in which those axioms can be tested.
one_run_limit: An exact formulation is plausible; a complete new general theory is not a one-run promise.

title: The English cycle-class sheet and its conventions
would_establish: A secure identification of the sheet and a bounded commentary on its trace, cycle and twist conventions.
known: The familiar cycle-class construction does not identify authorship or justify using Poincaré duality on arbitrary singular cycles. The preceding conventions and exact document remain missing.
first_step: Search by opening and closing wording and recover the preceding page before comparing the displayed trace argument with an exact published source.
one_run_limit: A source-identification and scope decision is feasible if the witness is found; no attribution should be inferred merely from its archival location.

title: The pure-category presentation and its omitted compatibilities
would_establish: A finite list of the relations needed to turn the proposed generators, Künneth data and inverted Tate projector into a precise universal construction.
known: Later correspondence and universal constructions impose cycle maps and composition compatibility explicitly. Numerical semisimplicity and faithful classical realizations are separate assertions.
first_step: Write the proposed presentation in generators and relations, mark each relation actually on the pages, and compare a single chosen modern realization category.
one_run_limit: A presentation audit is realistic. It should not be advertised as construction of all conjectural pure motives.

title: Two decisive readings before further local arguments
would_establish: A scan-based decision between sans/sous and s’identifie/intervient, which changes the strength of two assertions.
known: The diplomatic witnesses disagree. The double-blowup counterexample refutes whole-term identification, not the weaker assertion that a term contributes to a spectral sequence. Mathematical plausibility cannot settle the glyphs.
first_step: Once original scans114 and120 are available, inspect both exact phrases beside the two transcriptions and record visual evidence before editorial interpretation.
one_run_limit: Reach is1/5 with the present attachments and5/5 after the scans are supplied. This direction is ranked last operationally because its first required evidence is absent.
